Description: Permanent climate observation identifier
QC_Rule: No duplicates; no nulls; format must follow pattern

Description: Parent climate station identifier — links every observation to a permanent station
QC_Rule: Must resolve to G20 Station_ID; no nulls; station must be registered in G20 before observations can be entered

Description: Station name — carried from G20; do not edit here
QC_Rule: Must match G20 Station_Name for corresponding Station_ID; no nulls

Description: Date of observation — daily record
QC_Rule: No nulls; valid date; not future; >= 1950-01-01 for historical records

Description: Time period this record represents
QC_Rule: No nulls; allowed values only; must be consistent with actual date granularity

Description: State where station is located — from G20
QC_Rule: Must resolve to LKP_States.csv; consistent with G20

Description: Station latitude — from G20; do not change per observation
QC_Rule: Must match G20 Latitude for same Station_ID

Description: Station longitude — from G20; do not change per observation
QC_Rule: Must match G20 Longitude for same Station_ID

Description: Total rainfall in millimetres for the observation period
QC_Rule: If present must be >=0; flag daily values >200mm (verify with source); NULL if not recorded — not 0

Description: QC flag for Rainfall_mm: OK=verified; EST=estimated; SUS=suspect; MISS=missing
QC_Rule: Allowed values only; required if Rainfall_mm is populated

Description: Maximum temperature in degrees Celsius for the observation period
QC_Rule: If present must be -5–55; flag >45°C (possible sensor error)

Description: Minimum temperature in degrees Celsius
QC_Rule: If present must be -5–55; must be <= Temperature_Max_C

Description: Mean temperature in degrees Celsius
QC_Rule: If present must be -5–55; must be between Temperature_Min_C and Temperature_Max_C

Description: QC flag for temperature fields
QC_Rule: Allowed values only

Description: Relative humidity as percentage
QC_Rule: If present must be 0–100

Description: Wind speed in metres per second
QC_Rule: If present must be >=0; flag >50 m/s

Description: Whether this observation period recorded extreme rainfall event (project-defined threshold)
QC_Rule: Allowed values only; threshold must be documented in INDICATOR_REGISTER.csv IND01

Description: Rainfall threshold used to define extreme event for this record
QC_Rule: Required if Extreme_Rainfall_Flag = Yes; must be documented and consistent

Description: Number of consecutive dry days preceding this observation
QC_Rule: If present must be >=0

Allowed_Values: None, Mild, Moderate, Severe, Extreme, Unknown
Description: Drought classification for this period (based on approved drought index)
QC_Rule: Allowed values only; document which drought index was used

Description: Data source organisation — e.g. NiMet / ECMWF / ERA5
QC_Rule: No nulls

Description: Specific dataset name within source
QC_Rule: Free text

Description: Date data was obtained from source
QC_Rule: No nulls; valid date

Description: Unit system used — must be SI throughout
QC_Rule: No nulls; must be SI; document any conversions applied

Description: Processing status
QC_Rule: Must resolve to LKP_QC_Status.csv

Description: Date record entered
QC_Rule: Auto-populated; no nulls

Description: Date record last modified
QC_Rule: Auto-populated on update

Description: Data version
QC_Rule: No nulls

Description: Notes on data quality or special circumstances
QC_Rule: Free text
